about: The one safety text of the store listings in the EU's 24 official languages (docs/tasks.md, "Legal minimum" and "The listing's words"; GPSR Art. 9(7) and 19(d): the safety information in the offer, in a language the consumers of each Member State easily understand). Each language holds the heading word for Safety, the safety text, the maker line and the contact line. English (en) is the original: the safety text is the add-on's L["safety.note"] and contract/sheet.json's safety, the maker and the contact line are site/src/components/SafetyNote.astro's, and apple/fastlane/metadata/en-US/description.txt carries all four. The other 23 are translations made on 2026-11-10 without a native speaker's review: each keeps every symptom and condition, "that day" and "first", in the formal register of a consumer safety notice in its language, adds and drops no claim, and keeps the company's name, its address and the email address as they are (the country's name alone is translated). "clinician" is the word for a doctor in each, and "a session" the everyday word for an exercise session. 22 of the 24 stand in a listing, every language a Member State requires: Irish (ga) and Maltese (mt) are placed in none (ruled 2026-11-10; tools/store/locales.py's docstring has the sources), since Ireland's regulations ask for English (S.I. No. 726 of 2024, regulation 5) and English is relied on for Malta, which is not established at a primary source and David's to overrule; both translations stay here, since Malta's answer may change. The one source for tools/store/locales.py, which writes the App Store's localized listing folders (apple/fastlane/metadata/<locale>/) and Google Play's blocks (docs/store/play-listing-languages.md) and holds each to this file; after a change here, run `python3 -B tools/store/locales.py`.

bg.heading: Безопасност
bg.safety: Това е игра, а не медицински съвет. Спрете и потърсете помощ при болка в гърдите, припадане, необичаен задух или учестено сърцебиене. При силна мускулна болка, оток или тъмна урина след тренировка потърсете лекар още същия ден. Първо се консултирайте с лекар, ако имате сърдечно, белодробно, бъбречно или метаболитно заболяване или високо кръвно налягане, ако сте бременна или наскоро сте претърпели операция.

cs.heading: Bezpečnost
cs.safety: Toto je hra, ne lékařská rada. Při bolesti na hrudi, mdlobách, neobvyklé dušnosti nebo bušení srdce přestaňte a vyhledejte pomoc. Silná bolest svalů, otok nebo tmavá moč po cvičení vyžadují návštěvu lékaře ještě týž den. Nejprve se poraďte s lékařem, pokud máte onemocnění srdce, plic, ledvin nebo metabolické onemocnění či vysoký krevní tlak, jste těhotná nebo jste po nedávné operaci.

da.heading: Sikkerhed
da.safety: Et spil, ikke lægelig rådgivning. Stop, og søg hjælp ved brystsmerter, besvimelse, usædvanlig åndenød eller hjertebanken. Stærke muskelsmerter, hævelse eller mørk urin efter en træning kræver, at du søger læge samme dag. Spørg først en læge, hvis du har en hjerte-, lunge-, nyre- eller stofskiftesygdom eller forhøjet blodtryk, er gravid eller for nylig er blevet opereret.

de.heading: Sicherheit
de.safety: Ein Spiel, keine medizinische Beratung. Hören Sie auf und holen Sie Hilfe bei Brustschmerzen, Ohnmacht, ungewöhnlicher Atemnot oder Herzrasen. Starke Muskelschmerzen, Schwellungen oder dunkler Urin nach einer Trainingseinheit erfordern noch am selben Tag einen Arztbesuch. Holen Sie vorher ärztlichen Rat ein, wenn Sie eine Herz-, Lungen-, Nieren- oder Stoffwechselerkrankung oder Bluthochdruck haben, schwanger sind oder vor Kurzem operiert wurden.

Έντονος μυϊκός πόνος, πρήξιμο ή σκούρα ούρα μετά από μια προπόνηση απαιτούν επίσκεψη σε γιατρό την ίδια ημέρα. Συμβουλευτείτε πρώτα γιατρό αν έχετε καρδιακή, πνευμονική, νεφρική ή μεταβολική νόσο ή υψηλή αρτηριακή πίεση, αν είστε έγκυος ή αν υποβληθήκατε πρόσφατα σε χειρουργική επέμβαση.

en.heading: Safety
en.safety: A game, not medical advice. Stop and get help for chest pain, fainting, unusual breathlessness or a racing heart. Severe muscle pain, swelling or dark urine after a session needs a doctor that day. Ask a clinician first if you have heart, lung, kidney or metabolic disease or high blood pressure, are pregnant or had recent surgery.

Consulte antes a un médico si tiene una enfermedad cardíaca, pulmonar, renal o metabólica o hipertensión, si está embarazada o si se ha sometido recientemente a una operación.
